description: Make a finished short film from one idea: screenplay, storyboard frames (AI-reviewed), video clips with spoken dialogue, scene-synced soundtrack, stitched export. Or a music video: pass song_path (a local file) or song_url (your own PixelDojo upload from pixeldojo_upload, never a third-party link) with optional lyrics; the film is cut to that song, each clip lip-synced to its slice on the studio music video engine, and no score is composed: the export plays the song. Every named character must be cast (cast: your own images, a portrait prompt, or a Character Studio character) before frames render; cast entries can also replace or remove someone. Phased: plan is free; cast; produce starts charged generation; status advances production (poll every ~30s); redo renders a new take of chosen shots and status re-exports.

action.description: plan (default, free): writes the script and plans shots, returns film_id, a cost estimate, and any characters still to cast. cast: casts, replaces or removes characters on an existing film (pass film_id and cast). produce (charged): starts rendering frames; refused until every named character is cast. status: advances production one step and reports progress; call it every ~30s until it returns the finished film URL. redo (charged): renders a new take of the shots listed in `shots`, on a film in production or already finished; then call status, which saves the new take and cuts a new export with it.

aspect.description: Plan step: frame aspect ratio. Default 16:9.

cast.description: Cast members, one per named character. Every named character must be cast before frames render, so faces, ages and species hold in every shot. Pass them on the plan call (the script then stars them by name) or later with action "cast" using the names the plan reports. Each entry: name, plus ONE of image_urls (your own photos of an adult, made into a character), prompt (a portrait is generated from it, charged like any image), or character_id (a Character Studio character). An entry with only a name uses your Character Studio character of that name. A name that is already cast is left alone unless the entry sets replace: true, which hands that part (every shot, outfit and voice) to the new cast member. remove: true with only the name takes that cast member off the film; the part then needs a new cast member before frames render. replace and remove work until the shots of that cast member are rendered; after that, recast on the storyboard, where the frames that show them can be redone.

image_urls.description: Your own https photos of the character (1-8). PixelDojo uploads work; they are copied to permanent storage.

name.description: The character name as the film uses it (e.g. "Harlan").

prompt.description: A description to generate the portrait from: species if not human, gender, adult age, look and outfit (e.g. "man in his late 50s, grey mustache, sunburnt, red windbreaker").

remove.description: Take whoever plays this name off the film and every shot (free), before their shots are rendered. Give only the name.

replace.description: Swap out whoever already plays this name for the image_urls, prompt or character_id given here, before their shots are rendered. Without it, an already-cast name is left unchanged.

film_id.description: The film_id returned by the plan step. Required for produce, status and redo; with it, action "plan" is treated as "status".

idea.description: Plan step: one-to-three sentence film idea. The studio writes the screenplay (free). Provide idea or script. Keep the user's own words for who each character is, including their gender and pronouns ("she", "he") and species; the writer has nothing else to go on.

length.description: Plan step: target length. Default 60s. Ignored for a music video, whose length is the song.

look.description: Plan step: visual style carried through frames, clips and soundtrack. Story looks: live-action, anime, 3d-animation, noir, horror, sci-fi, documentary, western, romance, romantic-comedy, comedy (default live-action). Music video looks: rap-video, neon-club, stage-performance, retro-camcorder, y2k-pop, moody-rnb, rock-grit, dream-pop, k-pop (default rap-video).

lyrics.description: Plan step, music video mode (optional): the song lyrics, so shots land on the right lines.

music_job_id.description: The music_job_id from the previous status reply while the score is composing. A status call without it, once all clips are ready and no score is attached, starts and charges for a new score.

pacing.description: Plan step: 'story' (default) plays every shot's action whole, for any narrative film. 'trailer' cuts it like a trailer, promo or sizzle: most shots stay on screen 1.5-3 seconds. Ignored for a music video.

redo.description: Redo only: 'clip' (default) renders a new take of the clip from the same storyboard frame, the fix for a glitch, bad motion or lip sync. 'frame' paints a new frame first (and then a new clip from it), the fix for a wrong look, face or composition. Each is charged like any render of that shot. To change what a shot shows, edit it on the storyboard.

script.description: Plan step: a full screenplay (sluglines, action lines, dialogue) to plan instead of an idea.

shots.description: Redo only: the shots to render again, by the labels status and the finished film report ("2.3" is scene 2, shot 3), or by shot id.

song_duration_sec.description: Plan step, music video mode (optional): the song length in seconds. Omit it and the studio measures the song.

song_path.description: Plan step, music video mode: absolute local path to the song (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC up to 50MB). Uploaded for you; use instead of song_url.

song_url.description: Plan step, music video mode: URL of the song. It must be your own PixelDojo upload (from pixeldojo_upload or /api/v1/upload); a third-party link is refused. Makes a music video cut to this song, every clip lip-synced to its slice of it, rendered on the studio music video engine. idea (or script) describes the visuals. No score is composed: the song is the soundtrack.

soundtrack.description: Read on status calls once all clips are ready. scene-synced (default): one musical section per scene. flat: one cohesive bed. none: export without music. Ignored for a music video, which always exports with its song.

title: Make short film
